name: New Brunswick Funeral Directors Association Member Directory
publisher: New Brunswick Funeral Directors and Embalmers Association
licensing_notes: Public association member directory; membership is not treated as equivalent to a provincial licence register.
notes: Named member facilities and addresses are imported as medium-trust source records for research coverage.

name: Santé Québec Funeral Services Permit Directory
licensing_notes: Official 2026 directory of permitted funeral-services businesses and facilities.
notes: Active permit blocks are expanded into facility-level records; permit, business, director, phone, status, address, and city provenance are retained.

name: Funeral and Cremation Services Council of Saskatchewan Roster
publisher: Funeral and Cremation Services Council of Saskatchewan
licensing_notes: Official public roster of Saskatchewan funeral homes, crematoriums, and transfer services.
notes: The collector imports funeral-home license codes FH and FHC; crematorium-only and transfer-only license rows remain outside the funeral-home location inventory.

name: Consumer Protection BC Funeral Services Register
licensing_notes: Official public licence-search results for licensed funeral-service providers in British Columbia.
notes: Rows preserve legal business name, trade name, licence number, address, dates, and current licence status. Collection is read-only and does not infer closure from absence.

name: Alberta Funeral Services Regulatory Board
licensing_notes: Public regulatory source. Read-only establishment-type metadata is probed through the public verification session; protected establishment search is not automated.
notes: Session-aware read-only metadata probe implemented. It reports FUN and BOTH establishment classes when available and performs no database writes or CAPTCHA-protected search.

name: Bereavement Authority of Ontario Public Register
licensing_notes: Official public register of Ontario bereavement-sector licensees. Current Funeral Establishment Class 1 and Class 2 site records are imported from the public organization register export.
notes: Authoritative Ontario funeral-establishment source. The prepared import dataset contains current Class 1 and Class 2 funeral establishment sites only; FE/TS operator licences are retained separately and are not counted as additional funeral-home locations.

name: Funeral Board of Manitoba
licensing_notes: Official Province of Manitoba Funeral Board list of licenced funeral homes.
notes: 2026 authoritative PDF source. Raw source rows, missing fields, and repeated source rows are preserved during collection.

name: Manual Canadian Funeral Home Source
licensing_notes: User-supplied or manually researched public business records.
notes: Fallback metadata source for records supplied manually.

name: Manual Website Evidence Intake
licensing_notes: Researcher-supplied public business evidence. Retain source URLs, notes, and retrieval dates in the raw payload.
notes: Offline intake for manually researched website URLs attached to existing entity IDs. It creates reviewable candidates only and never approves or selects primary websites.

name: Nova Scotia Licensed Funeral Homes and Related Sellers
licensing_notes: Official open dataset. Verify the current licence and dataset metadata before redistribution.
notes: Includes licensed funeral homes, crematoriums, cemeteries, and funeral sellers. Importers must preserve the source category and filter it explicitly; absence is not a closure signal.
